blocks.x: Okay. We‘ll go ahead and stop, we‘ll take a break now.
You going to take a break?
Yeah, we went almost an hour. It‘s going by fast now, huh?
You‘re having fun, you‘re having fun. Time flies when you‘re having fun.
Oh, we working. That was one hour and we have two more to go, we‘ll be done.
Oh great, man, great. I hope…
I can leave you the address… ------
